steps.text: every branch ends REMOVE TAG → End Flow, and each Send Email step’s On bounced link leads to the same cleanup (V2): the spec carries it as onBounced, and the builder draws it (v52). A branch that just stops keeps in_flow_crash_delivery, and that person never gets another broadcast. Send a test contact down each exit before switching the flow on.

the export writes the greeting with the name rule: joe and JOE read Joe, JoAnn stays JoAnn, mcH reads McH, an empty name reads there (decision 123). The emails come from the master, so nothing is typed by hand
